cells: Task Evaluated: / Reporting a pump-related water-supply problem in TubigTugon

Step 1 / Action: On the Home screen, select Report a Problem. / Expected Result: The short report form opens. / Will users understand what to do? / YES [X]     NO [ ] / Comments: The button appears on the first screen and uses plain, direct wording. /

Step 2 / Action: Enter the location, describe the problem, provide a contact method, leave the name blank if preferred, and select Submit Report. / Expected Result: The system accepts the required details and proceeds to confirmation. / Will users notice the correct action? / YES [X]     NO [ ] / Comments: The short form uses familiar labels, marks the name as optional, and ends with one clear submit button. /

Step 3 / Action: Read the confirmation and select Back to Home. / Expected Result: The system states that the report was submitted and shows the submitted location and problem summary. / Will users understand the system response? / YES [X]     NO [ ] / Comments: The confirmation reduces uncertainty and the Back to Home button provides a clear next action. /
